title: Finite Audits of Model Updating: Coverage and Resolution of Paired Disparity Comparisons
abstract: arXiv:2609.09788v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Finite audits can become more precise and decisive without reliably covering the change in subgroup disparity. We study the updating-minus-frozen difference in absolute subgroup gaps, averaged over a fixed history, for true-positive and false-positive rates separately. Controlled paired-count experiments and independent audits of retained model histories distinguish interval coverage, erroneous conclusions and decision resolution. With a zero frozen gap and a five-percentage-point updating gap, bootstrap coverage is 12.0%; a numerical-delta alternative improves coverage to 52.9%, still far below the nominal 95%, with 500 smaller-group and 2,000 other-group observations of the specified outcome per window over ten windows. Unequal absolute-gap biases explain point-estimate displacement, and gap direction changes pairing's variance contribution. Prior strength materially affects sparse, off-centre comparisons. translated_title: 模型更新的有限审计：配对差异比较的覆盖率与分辨率
translated_abstract: 有限审计可以变得更加精确和果断，却无法可靠地覆盖子群体差异的变化。我们研究了在固定历史窗口上平均的、更新模型减去冻结模型在绝对子群体差距上的差异，并分别针对真阳性率和假阳性率进行分析。通过受控的配对计数实验以及对保留模型历史的独立审计，我们区分了区间覆盖率、错误结论与决策分辨率。在冻结差距为零、更新差距为五个百分点的情形下，bootstrap覆盖率为12.0%；一种数值差分的替代方法可将覆盖率提升至52.9%，但仍远低于名义上的95%（每窗口包含较小群体的500个与其他群体的2000个指定结果观测值，共十个窗口）。不相等的绝对差距偏差解释了点估计的位移，而差距方向会改变配对方法对方差的贡献。先验强度对稀疏且偏离中心的比较具有实质性影响。在保留的面板数据中……
tldr: 该论文发现，模型更新中的配对差异审计尽管更精确、更有决断力，其区间对子群体差距变化的覆盖率却远低于名义95%（bootstrap仅12.0%，数值差分替代方法也仅52.9%），且绝对差距偏差、差距方向与先验强度会显著影响点估计与结论。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that paired disparity comparisons in finite model-updating audits, despite being more precise and decisive, achieve interval coverage far below the nominal 95% (12.0% with bootstrap and 52.9% with a numerical-delta alternative), with unequal absolute-gap biases, gap direction, and prior strength materially affecting point estimates and conclusions.
